verdict.rationale: Relay's docs mention capturing receipts and categorizing expenses in real time, syncing to accounting software, but there's no evidence of automatic capture tied to card-swipe events specifically, nor of AI-native/agentic receipt matching workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic receipt capture triggered at point-of-sale/card-use moment, details on OCR/AI coding mechanism, and independent confirmation this works without manual entry.
